steps.name: 시험 시트 zsheetai 만들기(PUT - 새 문서, 요청 비우기)
steps.js: const p=await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetai',{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:"{\"id\":\"zsheetai\",\"kind\":\"sheet\",\"title\":\"AI 변경 시험\",\"slides\":[],\"sheets\":[{\"id\":\"t01\",\"name\":\"AI\",\"cells\":{\"A1\":\"원래 A1\",\"B2\":10,\"C3\":\"그대로\"}}]}"}); const l=await (await fetch('/api/requests/zsheetai')).json(); for (const q of (Array.isArray(l)?l:[])) await fetch('/api/requests/zsheetai',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'delete',id:q.id})}); return p.ok || ('put '+p.status);

steps.name: AI 처리 → 완료: 바뀐 셀 2개를 초록 테두리로 강조하고 알린다
카드 [강조 끄기] → 테두리 사라짐 · [보기] → 다시
steps.js: const b=()=>document.querySelector('#reqList [data-aishow]'); b().click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const off=document.querySelectorAll('#marks .aiCell').length; b().click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const on=document.querySelectorAll('#marks .aiCell').length; return off===0 && on===2 ? true : JSON.stringify({off,on});

steps.name: 사람이 B2 를 고친 뒤 [되돌리기] - A1 만 AI 전으로, B2 는 사람 값 그대로
steps.js: { const td=document.querySelector('td[data-r="1"][data-c="1"]'); td.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mousedown",{bubbles:true,button:0})); window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mouseup")); const ed=document.querySelector("#editor"); ed.value="33"; ed.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true})); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"Enter",bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); } await until(async () => (!window.NexaSheet.S.dirty && ((await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetai',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells).B2===33), 8000); document.querySelector('#reqList [data-aiundo]').click(); await until(async () => (((await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetai',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells).A1==='원래 A1'), 8000); const c=(await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetai',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells; const t=document.querySelector('#toast').textContent; return c.A1==='원래 A1' && c.B2===33 && c.C3==='그대로' && /1개를 되돌렸습니다/.test(t) && /고친 1개/.test(t) ? true : JSON.stringify({c,t});

steps.name: 되돌린 뒤 Ctrl+Z - AI 값으로 다시
steps.js: document.querySelector("#editor").focus(); document.querySelector("#editor").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"z",ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); await until(async () => (((await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetai',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells).A1==='AI 가 고친 A1'), 8000); const c=(await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetai',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells; return c.A1==='AI 가 고친 A1' && c.B2===33 ? true : JSON.stringify(c);
